verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ramp lets admins instantly spin up cards with spend controls tied to approvals (ramp-comm-2), and Ramp is generally described as a card/expense platform, but the evidence pack lacks any explicit documentation of department/program-level budget setting with automatically enforced limits. missing for 10: dedicated docs on budget creation by department/program, enforcement mechanics (hard vs soft limits), and reporting/alerts tied to budget thresholds.
